scope: Read-only classification of pre-existing Main tests exposed by the embedding-boundary full check; no production fixes

method.mainTestSource: All six inspected test files are byte-identical to Main 999b60d (git diff --quiet exit 0).
method.agentSourceProbe: baseline-agent-contract-probe.mjs loads actual Agent source from git show b303b35, transpiles it in memory, and uses fixture HTTP plus a no-op logger. All 41 loaded Agent modules were byte-identical to the working tree at probe time.
method.limits: The representative baseline-source probe is not a clean-checkout run of the entire Main suite. Isolated current-package reruns reproduce the same failures and the source/provenance comparison identifies the relevant baseline behavior.
method.network: No real model or API calls; no operator credentials read or printed.
method.mutations: Only these authorized ledger artifacts were written during classification. Product and test files were not changed. Test runner uses its existing temporary sandbox.

failures.classification: Baseline fixture incompatible with the already-integrated provider SDK, unrelated to embedding changes
evidence: Fetch stubs at lines 192, 229, 274, 305, 335, 370 return plain objects without iterable Response.headers.
Agent SDK provider-utils extractResponseHeaders reads [...response.headers]; OpenAI SDK integration is already present in commits 36d34a6/f863c52 before b303b35.
The baseline-source Gateway probe produces response.headers is not iterable for the legacy fixture and Hello! for a real fixture Response.
failures.futureRepairBoundary: Update controlled HTTP fixtures to the documented Response/SDK shape; do not weaken SDK or embedding production behavior. Not implemented here.

failures.classification: Baseline identity assertion contradicts the immutable registry-view contract
evidence: Line 229 requires passedCtx.toolRegistry === TOOL_REGISTRY.
Agent src/tools/runtime/router.ts:193-199 has injected createToolRegistryView since 94df98f.
Agent src/tools/runtime/selection.ts:75 returns a new frozen registry while preserving actual handler references.
Baseline probe: sameIdentity=false, frozen=true, sameHandler=true.
failures.futureRepairBoundary: Assert projected contents, restrictions and handler identity rather than global object identity. Not implemented here.

failures.classification: Baseline fixtures count requested operations as completed without business receipts
evidence: makeToolCall at lines 18-20 only returns tool/name/args; several legacy knowledge cases also omit an explicit submit/manage action.
Agent src/agent/evaluation/gateEvaluators.ts:270 uses collectSuccessfulEvolutionIds since 1b394ce.
Agent src/agent/utils/toolOutcomes.ts:17 requires a result/envelope; lines 75-114 classify confirmed operation outcomes.
Baseline probe: request-only skip_evolution yields processed=0/retry; result.status=evolution_skipped yields processed=1/pass.
failures.futureRepairBoundary: Model actual accepted operation/action and success receipts; retain failed/unknown-result negative cases. Do not relax the success gate. Not implemented here.

failures.classification: Baseline expectations omit the record_repair branch
evidence: Lines 74-77 and 197-199 expect analysis_retry for missing note_finding calls.
Agent src/agent/evaluation/qualityGates.ts:243-250 selects record_repair when depth/breadth/coherence are adequate; these lines blame to 6f04514 and exist in b303b35.
Baseline probe returns pass=false/action=record_repair with the same missing-note reason.
failures.futureRepairBoundary: Align expectations with record repair versus renewed analysis; do not alter fact/quality thresholds. Not implemented here.

failures.classification: Deterministic baseline request/reply contract mismatch, not a timing flake
evidence: Lines 118-137 deliberately expect request() to resolve from its own published request, with no reply subscriber.
Agent src/agent/runtime/AgentEventBus.ts:125 excludes the original request event type; the fix is from 1b394ce.
Agent test/hook-system.test.ts:6-19 already requires no-reply timeout and matching external reply success.
Baseline probe: no subscriber times out at a shortened 10ms budget; a matching reply subscriber resolves test:reply. Isolated original Main test still times out at its unchanged 5000ms budget.
failures.futureRepairBoundary: Test real reply correlation and separately assert no-reply timeout. Do not restore self-acknowledgement. Not implemented here.

failures.classification: Baseline request-only knowledge fixtures do not meet persisted-submission requirements
evidence: Lines 335-339 and 349-353 supply only tool/name=knowledge and expect file-reference checks to be bypassed.
Agent src/agent/policies/QualityGatePolicy.ts:42 uses isPersistedSubmission since 1b394ce.
Agent src/agent/utils/toolOutcomes.ts:54-71 requires knowledge.submit plus status=created, nonempty id and pending/staging lifecycle.
Baseline probe: request-only fixture is rejected for 0/3 file refs; a persisted submission receipt passes.
failures.futureRepairBoundary: Supply an actual submit receipt for positive cases and preserve request-only negative coverage. Not implemented here.

conclusion: The classified 22 failures already follow the specified baseline contracts and do not traverse the new independent embedding assembly. This does not make the full Main check green; unrelated Core IndexingPipeline and database-lock failures are handled separately by the root agent.
